usable_positive_fields: RHEA ID; balanced equation; ChEBI participants; EC/UniProt mappings via Rhea/UniProt
best_use: High-trust exact reaction validation and ChEBI-normalized positive pairs.
negative_sample_role: Do not use absence from Rhea as a hard negative.
main_gate: Exact substrate/product structure and direction must match; gut/microbial context must be verified separately.

usable_positive_fields: reaction SMARTS; source reaction; EC; linked compounds; sequences; source dataset
best_use: Recover missing rule families after exact source reactions are identified.
negative_sample_role: Rule-generated non-target products can be ranking decoys only after false-negative screen.
main_gate: Need provenance to exact source reaction and atom-mapping/radius choice.

best_use: Broad enzymatic reaction expansion and EC-balanced screening.
negative_sample_role: Use as false-negative screen before labeling generated decoys as hard negatives.
main_gate: Not gut-specific; source provenance and duplicated/general reactions must be audited.

usable_positive_fields: processed reactions; EC; mapped/balanced reaction; optional protein info in v2
best_use: Derive/validate atom-mapped templates for missing enzyme reaction families.
negative_sample_role: False-negative screen and reaction-family neighbor search.
main_gate: Check version, BRENDA-derived provenance, exact structure mapping, and license/citation.

usable_positive_fields: reaction IDs; metabolite IDs/structures; strain/taxon model context
best_use: Gut microbial capacity and taxon-reaction support.
negative_sample_role: Model absence is not a hard negative; can support conditional unknown labels.
main_gate: Reconstruction evidence is not the same as direct experiment.

usable_positive_fields: reaction database IDs; pathway assignments; genome-based reaction presence
best_use: Microbe-specific capacity screens and route-context evidence.
negative_sample_role: Gene/reaction absence is condition-dependent; use as unlabeled/conditional negative only.
main_gate: Do not convert gap-filled or predicted model reactions into gold positives.

usable_positive_fields: microbe; substrate/metabolite; gene; PMID; disease/host context
